title: Bleichenbacher padding oracle in RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 decryption in jose
description: CVE-2026-65626 is a vulnerability involving a Bleichenbacher padding oracle attack in the RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 decryption implementation within the jose library, specifically affecting version 3.0. The vulnerability allows an attacker to exploit the padding oracle to potentially decrypt RSA-encrypted messages without the private key. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
